svg.title: A Windows VM with Microsoft Entra sign-in
svg.desc: Four numbered steps. 1: your PC connects over RDP, TCP 3389, to the temporary public IP pip-azb-win01. 2: the network security group nsg-azb-vm on the subnet snet-vm allows 3389 from your IP only. 3: the Microsoft Entra sign-in extension on the VM vm-azb-win01 checks the sign-in with Microsoft Entra ID over port 443. 4: the group TestUsers, with testuser1, holds the role Virtual Machine User Login on the resource group rg-azb-lab, so the check passes.
